_about: The Lv 30 ascensions: element, stat changes, ultimate, and the numbers their passive uses. From the old game's SPEC and SPECS tables.

ascensions.name: Berserker
ascensions.passive: Bloodlust: +40% damage while below half HP. Kills heal you 15%.

ascensions.name: Paladin
ascensions.passive: Aegis: allies next to you take 20% less damage. Your hits heal you for 20%.

ascensions.name: Duelist
ascensions.passive: Riposte: when hit in melee, you strike back for 60%.

ascensions.name: Juggernaut
ascensions.passive: Unstoppable: immune to stun, snare and armor break.

ascensions.name: Guardian
ascensions.passive: Bodyguard: you take hits aimed at adjacent allies, with 30% less damage.

ascensions.name: Warlord
ascensions.passive: Battle Aura: allies within 2 tiles (and you) deal 15% more damage.

ascensions.name: Pyromancer
ascensions.passive: Fire skills deal 40% more damage and burn (bleed 2).

ascensions.name: Cryomancer
ascensions.passive: Ice skills always snare. Snared enemies take 25% more damage from you.

ascensions.name: Stormcaller
ascensions.passive: Every attack arcs to one more enemy nearby for 50%.

ascensions.name: Saint
ascensions.passive: Overheal: healing beyond max HP becomes a shield.

ascensions.name: Oracle
ascensions.passive: Foresight: healed allies get Haste (+2 Move). Divine Grace no longer roots you.

ascensions.name: Plague Doctor
ascensions.passive: Contagion: your attacks cause bleed and heal your most hurt ally for 50% of the damage.

ascensions.name: Sniper
ascensions.passive: Steady Aim: +35% damage if you haven't moved this turn. Ignores 30% DEF.

ascensions.name: Trapper
ascensions.passive: Hunter's Mark: snared or stunned enemies take 30% more damage from you.

ascensions.name: Tempest Archer
ascensions.passive: Hit and Run: you can still move after attacking if you haven't moved yet.

ascensions.name: Phantom
ascensions.passive: Evasion: 30% chance to dodge any attack.

ascensions.name: Viper
ascensions.passive: Toxin: every hit causes bleed 3. Bleeding enemies take 30% more damage from you.

ascensions.name: Blade Dancer
ascensions.passive: Dance of Blades: once per turn, a kill lets you act again.

ascensions.name: Outlaw
ascensions.passive: Fan the Hammer: single-shot skills fire twice at 60% damage.

ascensions.name: Bounty Hunter
ascensions.passive: Bounty: +50% damage to elites and bosses. Kills give double gold.

ascensions.name: Trickshot
ascensions.passive: Ricochet Master: every shot bounces to one more nearby enemy for 60%.

ascensions.name: Inferno Rider
ascensions.passive: Fire skills deal 40% more damage and burn (bleed 2).

ascensions.name: Frost Wyrm
ascensions.passive: Frost Breath: every attack snares. Immune to snare.

ascensions.name: Storm Dragoon
ascensions.passive: Sky Dive has no cooldown.

ascensions.name: Necromancer
ascensions.passive: Soul Harvest: each new kind of normal monster you kill can become a Raise skill on one of your 4 skill buttons. A raised monster spawns once per floor; if it moves or attacks you can't, and vice versa.

ascensions.name: Blood Witch
ascensions.passive: Blood Magic: spells cost 5% HP but deal 40% more and heal you for 20% of the damage.

ascensions.name: Hex Queen
ascensions.passive: Queen of Curses: your debuffs last 1 turn longer, and every enemy with a debuff takes 25% more damage from your whole party.

ascensions.name: Templar
ascensions.passive: Holy Charge: after charging 3+ tiles, your hit heals allies next to the target for 15% of their max HP.

ascensions.name: Black Knight
ascensions.passive: Dread: single-target attacks deal 40% more. Your kills terrify (stun) adjacent enemies.

ascensions.name: Storm Rider
ascensions.passive: Thunder Gallop: charge bonus is doubled (+24% per tile, max +120%).
